instruction: Make an LEC-style broadcast overlay. Give the top scoreboard a teal section for the left team, an orange section for the right, and a dark center for the score and clock. Use bold, condensed white lettering and sharp edges. Along the bottom, create tightly packed player tables with items toward the outside and champion portraits, names and stats toward the middle. Keep it clean and functional, with little decoration.
